title: PAPERBOAT
author: Soumya Sephali Sahoo
text:
Martha had high hopes
Grand dreams and tall ambitions.
To touch the clouds
To sail on yachts.
To roam around in Venice
To dine with the celebrities
To buy entire supermarkets
To study in Oxford
To ride in lavish cars
To drink the richest wine
To play an electric guitar
To have the most fruitful garden
To wear the latest clothes
To be the talk of the town
To smell like the richest woman
To purchase fancy flowers
To have a whole library
To wear the costliest diamonds
To own a mansion and
To eat exotic dishes.

But the more she tried to
Sail on a luxury cruise,
Fate intervened to show
That hers was a paperboat.
